Root Cause: The condition `if(getTaste < taste)` is incorrect for comparing and updating taste values. The logic should compare in the reverse direction, i.e., `if(getTaste > taste)` to ensure the correct taste value is maintained in the map.
suggestion: Suggestion 1. Correct the comparison operator Change the condition within the `if` statement to `if(getTaste > taste)` instead of `if(getTaste < taste)`. This will ensure that the map will store the higher taste value when comparing the current taste with the stored taste.
